state.context: Authorized point-in-time local security audit. Parent existing make check and npm audit pass, four synthetic vulnerability checks fail expected security assertions. No application source fixes. Scores are advisory, independent human final review required.

findings.title: Old-password login survives password recovery
findings.evidence: Isolated real auth.Service tests commit ChangePassword or ResetPassword after Login reads old hash but before verification returns. Both then create a valid seven-day session using old password. Requires knowing old password and racing recovery; no anonymous password bypass.

findings.title: IP-address peer certificate identity bypass
findings.evidence: Actual NewHTTPClient with IP URL accepts a locally trusted synthetic certificate valid only for unrelated DNS name when nonmatching pin is configured. TLS 1.2 and1.3 both reproduced. Ordinary verifier with same roots rejects. Exploit needs network interception, a certificate trusted by selected roots, configured pin, IP-address URL. Peer credentials grant root-equivalent remote powers.

findings.title: Active streams survive session revocation
findings.evidence: Real HTTP /api/events stream continues delivering new events after logout, password change by second session, or clock expiry. Fresh GET/api/me rejects same cookie401 in all controls. Log/metrics/forward/peer unpair coverage is static inference; only existing read streams persist, no new request bypass.

findings.title: Reverse proxy clients share login lockout
findings.evidence: HTTP handler regression simulates same loopback TCP peer with two XFF client addresses: five wrong passwords from one client cause correct password from second client429. Production window15min; password change same limiter source. Needs accessible shared reverse proxy; no credential theft.

findings.title: Known vulnerable local Go compiler and no release minimum patch gate
findings.evidence: Local Go1.26.4 source scan v1.9.0 DB2026-10-20 returns24 IDs,18 with symbol traces including unauthenticated static Range CPU advisory fixedGo1.26.9. go.mod minimum1.26.0, Makefile has no patch floor. Many traced HTTP2/Windows/CONNECT advisories not applicable to configured server; no deployed artifact inspection or CVE exploit executed. Rebuild patched compiler and enforce minimum.

findings.title: Unsigned release authenticity gap
findings.evidence: Documented existing accepted gap: default install and CLI upgrade verify checksum from same GitHub release as executable/installer. Build signing and install.sh --signers exist as opt-in, but no signer shipped and default policy does not require signature; CLI Source.Download verifies SHA256 only before executing installer. Compromised release publisher could replace binary and checksum. No account compromise or upstream tampering observed.

findings.title: Operation output has no global byte/TTL budget
findings.evidence: Earlier engineering F10 duplicate. Static limits20operations/stack,20k lines/op,8KiB/line imply about156MiB/op and3.05GiB/stack before overhead, not measured. No global lifetime bound or removed stack cleanup. Needs operator-triggered output or noisy build; admin is already root so not escalation.

findings.title: Relative extra build-context symlink can be repointed
findings.evidence: Existing GitHub#18 duplicate confirmed source: only absolute extra build contexts reject symlink rewriting, relative escaping extra/additional contexts remain lexical. Needs host write access to allowed directory and later build; root-equivalent admin model, no external unauthorized compromise claimed.

findings.title: No repository CI gate and main branch unprotected
findings.evidence: git tracked workflows empty, release docs explicitly defer CI; GitHub branches/main API protected=false at review. Existing make check passes but no enforced PR gate. Need deterministic checks and code/dependency scanning with least-privilege Actions. Not evidence all org policy bypassed.
